lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَغْلِى is in the derivative form: يَغْلى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
غ/ل/ي gh–l–y to boil; type of perfume.

Of this root, 2 forms occur in a single place each in the Qur’an:
يَغْلىِ yaghlı and غَلى ghaly.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَغْلى yaghlı [imperf. of غَلا ghalā] to boil

(44:45) كالمهل يَغْلِي‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏الْبُطُونِ ‏like molten tar boiling in the bellies.

entries.definitionHtml:
غَلى ghaly [v. n.] act of boiling

(44:46) كَغَلْىِ ‏الْحَمِيمِ like the boiling of hot water.
